article.headline: Red alert Delhi: heavy rain and 60 kmph winds batter capital
article.summary: The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert for all 11 Delhi districts on Monday due to heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and intense winds.
article.body:
Up to 60 kmph gusts and rainfall exceeding 15 mm per hour arrived with a western disturbance, forcing the India Meteorological Department to place the capital under a red alert. While the downpour caused waterlogging near Jhandewalan Temple and left trees uprooted across the city, flight operations at the Delhi airport continued to function normally.

The intense weather provides a temporary break from recent warm conditions, with temperatures dropping by 1 to 2 degrees. Despite the immediate relief, the India Meteorological Department expects daytime temperatures to return to a range of 31 to 35 degrees Celsius over the coming days. Residents remain advised to anticipate potential traffic delays and avoid low-lying areas prone to flooding as the system continues to move through the region.

Beyond Delhi, an orange alert remains active for Faridabad, Gurugram, Rohtak, and Sonipat in Haryana, alongside nine districts in Uttar Pradesh. These areas face similar threats of lightning and winds gusting between 40 and 60 kmph. Commuters are urged to check traffic advisories before traveling and stay in contact with airlines for any potential scheduling updates resulting from the ongoing instability.

The India Meteorological Department reported that the current spell of rain is part of a wider trend impacting northern India, with forecasts of isolated to scattered rainfall extending across several other states including Rajasthan, Punjab, and Himachal Pradesh. The department continues to monitor the atmosphere for further developments regarding lightning and wind activity.

article.headline: Tyler Huntley takes the reins as injured Lamar Jackson misses Falcons clash
article.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons due to an ankle injury.
article.body:
Tyler Huntley will make his 12th start for the Baltimore Ravens this Sunday after head coach Jesse Minter confirmed that star quarterback Lamar Jackson will not play. Jackson, who sustained an ankle injury during the team's Week 4 victory over the Tennessee Titans, remained a non-participant in practice throughout the week, leading to the decision to keep him sidelined for the upcoming matchup in Atlanta. 

The absence of the two-time AP NFL MVP presents a significant challenge for the 3-1 Ravens as they face a surging Atlanta Falcons team. Historically, Baltimore has struggled without their primary signal-caller, holding a 6-11 record in games Jackson has missed since he became the starter in 2018. The injury brings immediate concern regarding how much time the quarterback will miss, given his history of multiple-game absences in previous seasons.

Tyler Huntley, now in his sixth season and his second stint with Baltimore, steps into the starter role after completing 8 of 9 passes for 63 yards in relief during the win against Tennessee. Huntley holds a career record of 7-9 as a starter, including a 5-6 mark during his previous years with the Ravens. 

Beyond Jackson, the Ravens have also ruled out defensive end Trey Hendrickson for the Week 5 game due to a finger injury. The team continues to navigate a busy injury report, with further updates expected as they finalize preparations for the 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff.

article.headline: Tua Tagovailoa primed to start for Falcons following Michael Penix rib injury
article.summary: Tua Tagovailoa stepped in during overtime of Sunday's 30-23 loss to the Ravens after starter Michael Penix Jr. sustained a rib injury.
article.body:
Tua Tagovailoa's Falcons debut saw him take the field during an overtime possession, ending in an interception by Ravens defender Kyle Hamilton that sealed a 30-23 defeat. Tagovailoa entered the game to finish the match after starter Michael Penix Jr. was sidelined following a hard sack by linebacker Tavius Robinson with only 27 seconds remaining in regulation.

Should imaging confirm that Penix is unable to play, Tagovailoa is slated to take the starting role for the Falcons in their upcoming Week 6 home game against the Bears. This shift in the depth chart puts Tagovailoa ahead of Cooper Rush, who handled duties during the first two weeks of the season while Penix was recovering from previous surgery. The potential transition comes at a critical time for the team, as Penix was managing the offense through a competitive performance that included 240 passing yards and a touchdown.

Head coach Kevin Stefanski noted that the team expects to receive more definitive information on Penix's status in the coming days. Penix, who attempted to return to play during the overtime session, ultimately felt he could not perform at the level required to secure a victory. The injury occurred during a two-minute drill while the score was locked at 23-23, forcing the Falcons to rely on their backup options to close out the contest. The organization is now focused on the evaluation process as they prepare for the Bears matchup.

article.headline: Sengkang MP Jamus Lim hospitalized with pneumonia after catching Influenza A
article.summary: Workers' Party MP Jamus Lim was admitted to hospital over the weekend after his blood oxygen level dropped to the low 90s following Influenza A that developed into pneumonia, forcing him to suspend his regular duties.
article.body:
A sniffle caught on camera in Parliament on Oct 6 escalated into a full hospital admission for Sengkang MP Jamus Lim. The second-term MP was seen pausing between sentences while speaking on the Finance Bill, wiping his nose as he spoke. Marine Parade-Braddell Heights MP Diana Pang walked over to hand him a tissue.

Lim's blood oxygen saturation fell to the low 90s over the weekend, well below the 95-100 range for healthy individuals, forcing hospitalization. In a Facebook post on Oct 12, Lim said the initial sniffle had developed into a bad case of Influenza A before culminating in full-blown pneumonia. He initially intended to take only the remainder of the week off work but checked into hospital as his condition worsened.

The MP is unable to attend his regular duties, including Monday's Meet-the-People Session and weekly house visits and estate walks. However, his TeamSengkang volunteers have agreed to step up and continue the Meet-the-People Session as usual. Lim said he will work from hospital to clear appeal letters and respond to email backlog.

Health Minister Ong Ye Kung said the rise in respiratory ailments stems from haze conditions coinciding with Influenza A season, compounding the problem. The Ministry of Health activated both the Public Health Preparedness Clinic scheme and the Haze Subsidy Scheme from Oct 12.

news.og_desc: Carlos Alcaraz had a smooth debut at the ATP Masters 1000 Shanghai 2026 and already knows what the next step is on his roadmap to the title. The Spaniard will face Zizou Bergs, who eliminated Ignacio Buse with surprising decisiveness, disrupting the tournament's plans since the Peruvian was seeded and, therefore, a potential opponent in this third round for Carlos.At 27 years old, this Belgian player, who reached 33rd in the world this year, is now in the 39th position in the ATP ranking and has managed to recover from some recent tough losses; against Rodionov in the Davis Cup and Lehecka in Tokyo, in a very close match. He is an offensively minded player, with good hands and strong net play, who likes to take the initiative and apply pressure with all his shots.🔜 Carlos Alcaraz 🇪🇸 will play Zizou Bergs 🇧🇪 in the #RolexShanghaiMasters third round on Monday. H2H 1-0 (Tokyo 2025). https://t.co/RBleWhZfqb— Alcaraz Daily (@alcarazdaily) October 10, 2026Alcaraz faced Bergs last year in TokyoAlcaraz knows him well, having faced him once before. It was precisely during this Asian tour last year when the Murcian won 6-4 6-3. If Carlos is fully focused and maintains tactical order, as well as a good service level, he should have no problems defeating the Belgian, whose season has been heavily marked by agonizing losses in Grand Slam tournaments.Indeed, both at Wimbledon (in five sets against Fery) and at the US Open (in five sets against Botic), he suffered losses that sting forever, being aware that he was presented with great opportunities to explore his limits and accomplish something significant. It will be interesting to see what Zizou Bergs is capable of against Carlos Alcaraz at the ATP Masters 1000 Shanghai 2026.
